evidence_items.locator: Opening assessment following the product introduction
evidence_items.explanation: Hands-on testing supports concerns about launch reliability. Its limited task sample does not establish how frequently the product fails across ordinary use; the shopping example also involved separate browser sessions, and banking transfers were restricted tasks.

The launch disclosure reports substantial capability on a difficult browsing benchmark, qualifying a blanket description of poor performance. A benchmark score does not establish dependable completion of ordinary tasks or consistency across repeated attempts.

unresolved_gaps: No representative independent launch-version evaluation with repeated trials was located.
The available hands-on review and company benchmarks do not establish the prevalence of failures across ordinary advertised tasks.
